title: Entity
description: A tracked bin, tool, hand or plate: the entity row joined with its latest entity_state. Producers: partner entity store (identity, zone and box, built from vision's frames), orders (bin profiles), partner graph (propagated profiles). Synced to SpacetimeDB at about 5 Hz.

label.description: Human label: bin contents, tool class, hand side, or plate's ticket.

zone.description: Zone ID the entity is in, e.g. slot-4, plating-spot, wash, pass.

origin.description: How the entity entered the shift (safety rule: known-clean source). Set once by vision; never changes. Only shift_start and clean_stack start clean.

ticket_id.description: Plates only: set when the cook taps start ticket.
